diagnostics.illustrations: Each of the 12 E4 cells requires all 90 paired Graph S0/H2 differences. FIRST compute each line mean paired PV-speed difference using math.fsum in replicate order divided by 30; choose the line nearest the median of the three line means, with lexical line-ID tie-break. THEN choose within that line the environment nearest the median of its 30 paired differences, with smallest-replicate tie-break. Medians use NumPy2.1.2 quantile(0.5, method=linear); no epsilon ties. Retain the matching H2 trajectory. Partial cell => no representative selection. Illustration only, never inference or policy/training-line selection.
diagnostics.scope: all main S0 architectures plus B1/B2/H2 on E4; all W7 and E5 tasks; no extra episodes
diagnostics.window_weighting: sum velocity / vehicle-time exposure; empty exposure NA; preserve numerators/denominators

SAP.inference_limits: Pointwise descriptive approximate intervals conditional on frozen selection, not simultaneous or multiplicity-controlled. Per-cell p-values OFF; no automatic BH/BY. k=0 or absent H => NA; k=1 environment-only.

main.conditional: Graph C95 excludes the validation-infeasible line, not a test-screen failure. Always report k/3 and individual lines; no unconditional architecture ranking.
main.sensitivity: S_0.93 points/all-line plots and pass counts; all .97/.99 infeasible => NA, never fallback
main.weighting: equal whole validation-eligible lines, 30 environments, then equal 54 cells

SAP.missing: Affected planned full-grid estimand and CI = NA. No available-case bootstrap, no shrinking validation k, no imputation or test reselection. Technical retries retain exact task ID/seeds under separate budget.
SAP.new_diagnostic_choices: One-step minimum durations avoid arbitrary persistence filtering; spatial lags exhaust the 41-cell map; temporal lags 0..40 and onset offsets -20..20 are fixed prospectively, not outcome-selected.
